entries.msgstr: You can earn Battle Pass Points in {whiteSpanish_open}Last Stand{whiteSpanish_close} mode.

Fight against waves of enemies.
Battles in Tier VIII vehicles.
Your computer's performance is insufficient for this mode. You may experience issues with graphics and vehicle movement. Game client crashes are also likely.

This mode requires high computer performance.
You will experience issues with map loading, graphics, and vehicle movement. In case of insufficient performance, try a lower graphics quality in your Settings.
